note: Every point where a kill must leave state all-or-nothing (acceptance item 3). Enumerated in phase 1 because these are properties of the protocol rather than of any implementation; a list assembled later would be the boundaries somebody remembered.

boundaries.expect: no part of the collection is applied; prior state stands, unmarked

boundaries.after: the last object, before its commit
boundaries.expect: identical to mid-object — a partial read must never delete anything

boundaries.after: receiving commit, before the durable transaction
boundaries.expect: on restart the collection is at its previous generation; the batch is re-run

boundaries.during: the durable transaction that applies and advances generation
boundaries.expect: all of it or none of it; a generation may never advance over unapplied objects
applied and durable; a re-sent identical batch at the same generation is a no-op

boundaries.during: a reconnect checkpoint, after some collections
boundaries.expect: nothing in the checkpoint is promoted; the host stays unswept and resolves no finding

boundaries.after: the checkpoint manifest, before its terminal record
boundaries.expect: the hub discards the partial checkpoint and the host stays unswept

boundaries.after: promoting a checkpoint, before persisting finding lifecycle
boundaries.expect: on restart, findings freeze rather than resolve — unswept is not dark
